reason: Codex app-server accepts reasoning effort on turn/start, not thread/start or thread/resume. The protocol cases verify new, resumed, and plan-mode turns; the saved-goal case verifies Core's selected effort survives goal resume and continuation; the disposable authenticated LAN case verifies the goal-resume entry point still dispatches one turn.
exclusions: No UI, native, browser-origin, or frontend code changed. Four exact Python cases cover the adapter boundary, saved goal configuration, and authenticated LAN goal resume. Deployment runs no local tests or backups.
